note: The workbench is a runnable Easel instance with its own tuning layer. This record separates the two things the byte comparison used to conflate: the upstream baseline (read-only, proven against an upstream commit) and the local overlay (the tuning). A file listed in overlay.files is EXPECTED to differ from upstream; a file that is NOT listed must match upstream byte for byte. That is what makes tuning auditable instead of invisible.

instance.note: Re-installed on 2026-11-15 by scripts/easel_engine.py install into the repository's controlled runtime directory; the previous extracted candidate at D://Projects//_worktrees//easel-v030-rebuild-20261113b remains on disk as the rebuild source. Every baseline and overlay byte was compared before the copy, and the frontend was rebuilt here from the pinned source (tree_sha256 8ab3d814f2e8c8ac…, identical to the 2026-11-13 build).
instance.layout: Commit-pinned source archive rebuilt with repository-owned skill overlays and generated account profiles; upstream remote metadata is not present.

upstream.tree_sha256_method: sha256 of sorted POSIX path + NUL + git blob SHA-1 + LF
upstream.note: v0.3.0's tag was force-replaced upstream, so the tag name is not an identity. This commit SHA plus the blob comparison is the identity.
upstream.skill_root_note: v0.2.1 used skills/openclaw; v0.3.0 moved every skill to skills/builtin. The 114 skill directories are the same set.

overlay.directories_note: Local tuning directories; their currently installed bytes in the default clean candidate are checked against the SHA-256 digests below.
overlay.files_note: Our override of the upstream video-script skill: the per-account script rules and the benchmark playbook. Recorded here so the verifier knows to expect a difference instead of reporting a mismatch.
overlay.source_files_note: Exact byte copies of the current local tuning layer, retained as project-owned source for later approved reconstruction. Historical benchmark claims remain explicitly unverified until their source material is available.
overlay.digests_note: SHA-256 of the bytes observed in the default clean candidate on 2026-11-13. Missing, changed or unrecorded overlay files cause verification failure. The original extracted workbench snapshot is preserved separately as previous_instance_snapshot.

generated.directories_note: Installed or produced at runtime. Never hashed, never compared against upstream. The same rule the production runtime already uses for outputs/ and .venv.

generated_profiles.note: Expected SHA-256 values for current DNA projections. These are separate from overlay.digests, which record the bytes currently installed in the existing workbench.

policy.note: The upstream baseline is never edited in place. Tuning is a recorded overlay layer on top of it. If a file outside overlay.files and overlay.directories differs from upstream, that is a FAILURE, not a tuning.
policy.note2: This record says nothing about whether the workbench may publish, spend provider budget, or read account credentials. The guard in src/contentops/easel/guard.py decides that, and it denies those routes.

previous_instance_snapshot.note: The extracted rebuild candidate this instance superseded; kept for provenance.
